node.title: PMA stage 3 (the residue): many-petal, sub-Johnson regime with CORRELATED targets
node.statement: RESTATED after the pullback counterexample (verified): split L(D) = L_quot u L_lowdef u L_prim. The quotient-pullback stratum is REAL and exponential-in-M (pma_pullback_lists) — charged to the quotient-profile budget (M = O(log n) at the cutoff => poly-but-budgeted). The low-defect stratum is covered by the fixed-excess machinery. The corrected target: THE PRIMITIVE RESIDUAL — non-pullback, non-low-defect wide sub-Johnson lists are polynomial. The third appearance of strip-quotient-first (after XR's E2 caveat and F's scale recursion). || REFUTED (wave-8 audited import, 2026-07-16; both readings die): (i) master's polynomial-primitive-residual reading falls to pma_sigma_one_variable_defect_exact_hit_floor -- an EXPONENTIAL primitive wide-sub-Johnson residual at sigma=1 on poly-field rows (Linnik/Xylouris-based family; non-pullback, d=n/8 not low-defect, inside the wide regime d^2 <= d|T|); (ii) the sharpened finite n^6 Post allocation falls to pma_sigma_one_d4_generic_source_obstruction (exact first moment 2^104 > n^6 = 2^97 at (65537^2, 65536, 32768), integer-verified, escapes all three owners). Folder banked from the v4 pin with master's original statement preserved. The refutations sit OUTSIDE imgfib's entropy reserve (audited guard (b)) -- imgfib remains viable CONDITIONAL.
node.attack_surface: two independent angles: (a) correlated-target strengthening of GS (the c_i are scalars times a COMMON L_D — one-dimensional target space per petal); (b) descent: extras of the auxiliary problem are degree-d objects — the SAME problem at (k, sigma) -> (d+1, ...), strictly smaller; iterate until Johnson-safe. Q2.9 fixed-excess data calibrates both.
node.falsifier: an adversarial many-petal family (R3 attack) with super-poly auxiliary list
node.notes: E4 (PR #186): exact toy window F_109 l=3 d=5 — Johnson-covered rows empty, wide rows nonempty but tame (M=12: 2023 aux polys, max agreement 11). NO_SUPERPOLY_SIGNAL.
